description: Bach Prelude, BWV 1006a on guitar / BWV 1006 on violin. Real recording: Mateusz Kowalski. The synth follows published aligned note timing; B varies attack and tone. No recorded vibrato, slides or bow controls are inferred from note-only alignments. String/finger choices are inferred and audited under a conservative hand model. Local research audition; recording rights remain with its source.
question: Which synth is closer to the real performance?

audit.assumptions: Four left-hand fingers; pairwise reach limits in mm; held fingers retained; no duration truncation. Guitar index barres cannot cross lower/open held notes. Violin adjacent-string finger stops allowed. Designed adult-hand limits, not player-specific biomechanics.
